subject: Re: POC success criteria & scope — re-baseline request
messages:

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC success criteria & next steps

Hi Jordan —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary use case: knowledge retrieval + extractive summarization for internal docs.
- Evaluation focus: accuracy of retrieved passages (precision@5) and end-user satisfaction on summaries.
- Platform constraints: must run within Acme VPC, support 2 concurrent users for the trial, and integrate with their SSO.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) Precision@5 >= 0.75 on the supplied query set (50 queries)
2) Average summary helpfulness >= 4/5 on a 30-sample blind eval
3) Median inference latency <= 600ms (p50) for 512-token responses
4) No PII leakage; all logs retained as per Acme policy

POC plan & timeline:
- Trial config: dedicated trial env (single GPU), sample dataset ingest + test harness — target start: 2026-06-22
- Trial window: 2 weeks (2026-06-22 to 2026-07-06)
- Ownership: Marissa (AE) + Camila (Solutions Eng) will run onboarding; Rachel (CS) will handle quality monitoring and evals

Attachments: acme_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (draft evaluation plan), sample integration checklist.

Next steps:
- Jordan: confirm success criteria and list of stakeholders (tech + procurement) by end of day Monday (6/15)
- We will then send a revised POC SOW and trial config for procurement review

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmecorp.com>

Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap. A few updates / asks from our side after showing the plan to the product team: 

1) Additional use case: we'd like to fold in a customer-support summarization flow (incoming tickets -> one-paragraph summary + suggested tags). This is lower volume but high business value for the team. Can this be included in the same trial?

2) Success criteria adjustments:
- Precision@5: keep target 0.75 but we'd like an intermediate p25/p50 stability check during week 1
- Summary helpfulness: keep target 4/5 but evaluate separately for knowledge vs support summaries
- Latency: because support summaries will be ~256 tokens, acceptable median latency for that flow is p50 <= 400ms

3) Timeline / procurement: procurement needs a short SOW and an estimated cost for a 2-week trial + a follow-up 60-day pilot if we extend. They also asked for a short security checklist (SOC2 scope + data handling). I cc'd contracts.

If we can include the support use case, we'll sign off on the criteria pending your updated plan. Also attaching a short doc describing the support flow.

Jordan
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
jordan.lee@acmecorp.com

Hi Jordan —

Thanks — this is all good and we can accommodate the additional support summarization use case within the same trial. Below is an updated, re-baselined plan that incorporates your asks.

Updated scope (adds support summarization):
- Use cases: 1) Knowledge retrieval + extractive summarization (50-query eval)
             2) Support ticket summarization + tagging (30-ticket blind eval)

Updated success criteria:
- Retrieval Precision@5 >= 0.75 (with p25/p50 stability checks after first 48hrs)
- Knowledge summary helpfulness >= 4/5 (30-sample blind eval)
- Support summary helpfulness >= 4/5 (30-sample blind eval)
- Latency targets: knowledge p50 <= 600ms; support p50 <= 400ms
- No PII leakage; logs stored per Acme retention policy

Re-baselined timeline & ownership:
- Trial onboarding & ingest: 2026-06-22 to 2026-06-24 (Camila lead)
- Validation & early stability checks: 2026-06-25 to 2026-06-28 (Rachel lead)
- Final blind eval & results: 2026-06-29 to 2026-07-02
- Buffer / wrap-up & decision: 2026-07-03 to 2026-07-06

Deliverables we'll provide by 6/18 (to support procurement):
- Short SOW + trial cost estimate (Marissa)
- Security checklist + SOC2 scope doc (Camila)
- Updated evaluation workbook and test harness (Rachel)

Next steps / asks:
1) Jordan: please confirm stakeholder list and whether we should include an internal legal review before 6/18
2) Procurement (cc): please confirm required PO/SOW format or any procurement constraints
3) Acme: sign-off on re-baselined scope by 6/18 to keep the 6/22 start date

I've attached the updated trial config for our infra team to prepare the env.
